q1_issues.issue: "Iron bands" names the specific bands on that one lantern (a standing configuration, not a habitual or characteristic claim), so the distributing rule wrongly makes every iron band in the KB reinforce the Stilllight Lantern; the licensed route is a group witness as Agent of a single reinforce event.

notes: iron_band is correctly fused with only the head genus emitted, since a noun material modifier is never exposed (the steel_beam line). "The Stilllight Lantern" correctly gets one opaque name symbol, its Name atom, and the kind atom licensed by the kind word inside the name.
